title: Choose the keynote's visual world
question: The keynote must feel like a live developer event, preserve the 2026 product footage, and make Copilot's movement across surfaces visible.

options.label: Live Build Broadcast
options.lineage: developer-conference broadcast graphics, build telemetry, and the 2026 Copilot deck
options.thesis: The keynote behaves like a build going live: one intent triggers real agents, surfaces, checks, and visible results.
options.viewport: A bare black stage holds one oversized command; the first advance floods it with a diagonal cascade of IDE, CLI, GitHub, mobile, and App footage.
options.risk: It becomes another dashboard if status graphics outrank the human story.

options.label: The Cutting Bench
options.lineage: film workprints, edit rails, grease marks, and pinned trims
options.thesis: Every Copilot capability is a decisive cut in one continuous issue-to-merge film.
options.case: Excellent for the five real videos and narrative sequence; less immediately native to developer culture.
options.viewport: A black film strip crosses the room-sized screen; the active Copilot surface fills one punched frame while discarded chat fragments hang below.
options.risk: It can feel like film school unless code, commits, and checks remain visible.

options.label: Underground Demo Poster
options.lineage: silkscreened theatre bills, off-center ray bursts, and photographic collage
options.thesis: Copilot's surfaces radiate from one human intent like acts on a one-night-only developer bill.
options.case: The strongest room energy and audience identity; the hardest direction in which to keep technical detail calm.
options.viewport: A green ray burst fires from one prompt at the lower-left while IDE, CLI, GitHub, mobile, and App imagery collide at poster scale.
options.risk: It overwhelms the product if every slide becomes a poster instead of saving the burst for pivotal moments.

canonCard.label: Polished 2026 product keynote
canonCard.thesis: Keep the supplied deck's familiar GitHub product-story structure and execute it at full fidelity.
canonCard.viewport: A refined dark/light feature tour with real product footage, corrected copy, and preserved transitions.
canonCard.risk: Safe and coherent, but less memorable than a visual world built for this room.
